CustomField.description: The introducing span for the designator, quoted verbatim and byte-checked against the artifact like every other piece of evidence. The twenty-fourth stamp's mitigation for the wrong-referent hazard: a wrong name is not an invented quote and the byte check cannot catch it, so the claimed evidence for the resolution sits visibly on the row instead of being silent. A designator whose introducing quote does not byte-match is dropped with a note and the pair survives as self-subject-undecided.
CustomField.label: About (Introducing Quote)
